response.sql: SELECT AVG(group_avg_rental_rate) AS avg_group_rental_rate, AVG(group_film_count) AS avg_group_film_count FROM (SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate) AS group_avg_rental_rate, COUNT(*) AS group_film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY original_language_id) AS groups_by_language
